text:
Rosa (Partnerships): idea: single private-offer that bundles HW+SI with an escrowed seller-credit waterfall. aim: simple buy flow for customers, predictable payouts for partners. quick take?
Ben (Sales): big yes. sales needs one offer link. how do we show sellers their share? need clear payout schedule.
Ivy (Finance): must be traceable per month with GL mappings. prefer monthly vested payouts and a 90d clawback window. also want reversal rules for refunds.
Marco (Eng-Billing): doable. will add per-offer metadata: seller_waterfall, escrow_flag, milestone_hooks. need usage events to include offer_line_id and seller_tag. creating ticket INF-3033.
ops-bot: INF-3033 created - "offer-level escrow ledger + usage attribution" assigned to eng-billing.
Tess (Field Ops): ops wishlist: automated smoke test for deployment gate, webhook to SI on milestone release, and dashboard tile showing escrowed vs released amounts so AMs can track.
Rosa (Partnerships): sample tier structure i'm thinking: small: 30k/mo -> 10% list + 8% seller-credit; mid: 100k/mo -> 18% list + 18% seller-credit (staged split: 50/30/20); large: 300k+ -> 25% list + 25% seller-credit + co-marketing. include optional 5% upfront accelerator to aid SI PoC.
Ben (Sales): love the upfront accelerator. clarify non-refundable vs convertible. prefer convertible after deployment verification.
Ivy (Finance): convertible accelerator must be an escrowed liability until verification then moved to seller payout line item. add negative-usage reversal window 120d.
Marco (Eng-Billing): implementation plan: 1) extend usage schema, 2) ledger provisional entries monthly, 3) escrow flag toggles release on milestone webhook. will post RFC.
Rosa (Partnerships): owners: Ben -> sales UX + AM play, Tess -> ops checklist & smoke test, Marco -> INF-3033 + RFC, Ivy -> reconciliation spec. target: pilot with 2 partners in 6 weeks.
Ben (Sales): will prep seller-facing FAQ and single-offer demo.
Tess (Field Ops): will draft webhook payloads and dashboard mock.
Marco (Eng-Billing): will share RFC in #eng-billing by EOD Fri.
Rosa (Partnerships): thanks team. tagging for follow-ups. :sparkles:
